descriptions.preferred: This attractive, vigorous upright cultivar has purple-red straplike leaves and a distinctive layered bamboo-like appearance and shape. The name 'Beni Otake' means "big red bamboo." The deep purple-red foliage is outstanding in the spring, the red color holding throughout the summer and then changing to a vivid crimson in the fall. The large widely spread seven-lobed, occasionally five-lobed, leaves are 9-11 cm long and 10-13 cm wide. Each straplike lobe is long and narrow, but broader than most linearilobums, varying from 3 to 10 mm wide, with long tail-like pointed tips and sharply pointed teeth along most margins. The more vigorous juvenile shoots carry broad matsumurae-like leaves with the lobes up to 2 cm wide. 'Beni Otake' forms a vigorous, upright tree which may reach 8 m high at maturity. sources.title: 红竹Acer Palmatum 'Beni Otake'
sources.description: 红竹树形直立、长势强健、极具魅力，它叶形如丝带， 外观和树形与众不同，如同竹子。春季新叶是出众的深 紫红色，而且可以保持到夏季，夏季先转为棕红色后转 为绿色，秋季则变为明亮的深红色。它的大叶子通常为 5-7 裂。裂叶狭长，但比多数线叶组枫树宽，叶尖较长， 形似尾巴，大多数叶缘锯齿锋利。更有活力的幼年枝会 长出类似山红叶的宽阔叶片，最宽的裂叶可达 2cm。 红竹树形直立，长势强健，株高可达 3.5m，但时常会 长成高大宽广的灌木状。艾德伍德率先从籽播苗中发现 了这一品种，随后由美国俄勒冈州 Hillsboro 市的 T.C 植物公司发布。它的名字意为"巨大的红色竹子"。

rhs.description: A deciduous, small tree to 4m tall, initially vase-shaped before becoming more rounded with age. The lobed leaves with narrow, strap-like leaflets emerge scarlet in spring, maturing to a deep purplish-red and then green before turning crimson in autumn

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this linearilobum group have long, narrow, strap-like lobes, with lightly serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这一迷人的强健直立型品种具有紫红色带状叶，整体层叠感明显，株形颇似竹子。名称 'Beni Otake' 意为“高大的红竹”。其深紫红色叶片在春季尤为出色，红色可持续整个夏季，秋季再转为鲜艳的深红色。叶片大而开展，通常为 7 裂，偶有 5 裂，长 9-11 厘米、宽 10-13 厘米。每一裂片均呈带状，细长而狭，比大多数 linearilobum 类型更宽，宽度约 3-10 毫米，先端具长尾状尖头，叶缘大部分带有锐尖锯齿。生长更旺盛的幼年枝条上会着生较宽、类似 matsumurae 型的叶片，裂片宽度可达 2 厘米。'Beni Otake' 可形成生长强健的直立乔木，成熟时高可达 8 米。最初由 Edward Wood 发现，为一株偶然获得的实生苗，后由美国俄勒冈州 Hillsboro 的 T. attributes.hort_group_description: 此 linearilobum 组的槭树具有细长、带状的裂片，叶缘具浅锯齿。

care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶小乔木，高可达 4 米，幼年树形初呈花瓶状，随树龄增长逐渐变得更圆整。叶片具裂，裂片狭长近带状，春季萌发时呈猩红色，随后成熟为深紫红色，再转绿，秋季则变为深红色。
